definitions.explanation: The acrobatic performance of walking across a stretched rope or wire.
A figurative use describing a situation where one manages a dangerous or delicate balance, often with little margin for error.

examples.japanese: ⟦サーカス→サーカス：20826_saakasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綱渡|つなわた}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the tightrope walking at the circus.

examples.japanese: {綱渡|つなわた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The tightrope performer advanced while maintaining balance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綱渡|つなわた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のんだ。
examples.english: The audience held their breath at the tightrope walk ten meters up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{綱渡|つなわた}りだ。
examples.english: Our monthly household budget is a tightrope act.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦ぎりぎり→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綱渡|つなわた}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The precarious juggling of barely meeting deadlines continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{持|も}ちし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{綱渡|つなわた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧だ。
examples.english: Juggling two jobs while raising children is truly a daily tightrope act.

notes:
Literally "rope crossing" — composed of ⟦{綱|つな}→綱：03891_tsuna⟧ (rope) + ⟦{渡|わた}り→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (crossing). The figurative sense is extremely common in everyday Japanese, used whenever describing a precarious situation with little room for error.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綱渡|つなわた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ (precarious daily life)
- {綱渡|つなわた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (precarious management)
- {綱渡|つなわた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (precarious state)
- {綱渡|つなわた}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (keep walking the tightrope)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薄氷|はくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ — to tread on thin ice (similar figurative sense of danger)
- ⟦{危|あや}うい→危うい：11825_ayaui⟧ — dangerous, precarious (adjective describing the state itself)
